mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and a comfortable temperature of 72 degrees, though it feels a bit warmer at 79 degrees out at Fireman's Park.

The City of Verona has released official notices for the upcoming fall primary and November elections. Additionally, construction work is set to begin on Highway M on August 18, which will result in lane shifts and the temporary closure of the Alliant and Kwik Trip driveway.

There is plenty to do in our community. Today, you can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy live music at Concerts in the Park, or join the fun at Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In our weekly police report, on August 5, officers arrested a 37-year-old man on Whalen Road for a probation violation warrant after he attempted to flee from the scene.

You are in for a treat with today's flavor of the day, Devil's Food Cake. Culver's of Verona is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM. If you miss out, tomorrow's flavor is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough.
